It depends on the course. Generally speaking, a paid plan with an AI provider is recommended. Each course page lists the specific tools and subscriptions you will need.
The live sessions will be primarily text-based - more like a Twitch livestream than a traditional workshop.

The course assumes you are using an AI assistant to complete it. Every exercise is a prompt. I believe that building with AI is the best way to learn how to use AI in your daily life. So yes - you'll definitely get better at using AI after this course.
Prerequisites vary by course. Check the specific course page for details.
Most AI Hero courses are designed to be completed with an AI coding assistant. Check the specific course page for which tools are required.

There are no hidden special discounts available. We support purchase power parity (PPP), based on IP address of the computer you are using to make the purchase. Note that this system isn't perfect, and the discount does not always display. Keep in mind, If you use the PPP discount your purchase will be restricted to the country you purchased it from!
No, the only available options for purchase are those currently on the site.

PPP purchases are limited to the content displayed at time of purchase, and any current or future bonus materials/content/features may not be available. When in doubt, if you want to guarantee access to everything, purchase the product without the PPP discount.

When purchasing a team seat, you will be sent a link that can be used to register the number of accounts you have bought. Licenses are non-transferrable, i.e. a license cannot be reassigned from one person to another.
Team licenses are actually coupon codes that can be redeemed by users. They are owned by the individual who claims the seat, not the company. Licenses cannot be transferred or "passed around".
Yes, after purchase you will find a text area that allows you to put any arbitrary information into the invoice PDF/printable.

Yes! The easiest way to gift a license is to enter their email address instead of your own. Note that there may be a verification code they will receive that you will have to request from them. Also, if using PPP it is important that you are both in the same country, or else your gift recipient will be unable to access the content. You are also able to purchase a team license and distribute links that way.
Yes, by contacting the support team at [team@aihero.dev](mailto:team@aihero.dev?subject=AI%Hero:%20Email%20Change%20Request). Note that you cannot transfer your license to another person.
Yes! You can email the AI Hero Support Team: [team@aihero.dev](mailto:team@aihero.dev?subject=AI%Hero:%20Email%20Question)
